_comment: The optimizer commit whose agent list (path below) the compiled-in
snapshot of. It is separate from optimizer-test-pin.json on purpose: a
test-pin bump never changes the table. To move it, set optimizer_commit
and sha256 (of the file at that commit) together, then run
tools/gen_known_agent_table.py generate on a copy of the file; the
pull-request tier fails when the snapshot and the pinned file differ.
